main.name: Swaleha
main.description: Dedicated Full Stack Developer with QA Expertise
main.bio: Hi, I’m Swaleha — a results-driven Full Stack Developer and QA Analyst with over 3 years of experience delivering scalable, high-performance applications and quality-assured solutions. I specialize in React, Node.js, .NET, Playwright, Postman, and Azure DevOps, with a strong track record of leading end-to-end development and comprehensive testing for complex projects. At Encubate Tech Private Limited, I spearheaded full-cycle application development, conducted rigorous manual and automated testing, performed API validation, and implemented test automation frameworks to ensure seamless, bug-free releases. My approach combines clean, maintainable code with meticulous QA practices, enabling teams to deliver reliable software on time. I am passionate about building robust, user-focused applications while maintaining the highest quality standards through collaborative processes. Let’s connect and bring exceptional software to life.
main.contactmessage: Feel free to reach out for collaborations, consulting, or project opportunities.

resume.skillmessage: Here are some of my skills and qualifications -

work.title: Full Stack Developer
work.description: At BluWave Labs—a Canadian open-source incubator building impactful B2B/SaaS tools like VerifyWise—I lead full-stack development for the VerifyWise platform, an open-source AI governance solution. I design and implement scalable backend services using TypeScript and Node.js, and develop interactive, user-focused front-end components with JavaScript and React. I integrate third-party APIs for verification workflows, optimize database queries, and apply security best practices throughout the application. I collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver new features, improve performance, and ensure smooth CI/CD deployments using Azure DevOps.

work.company: Professional Development & Freelance Work | Remote, Canada
work.title: Full Stack Developer (Freelance & Open Source)
work.description: Focused on professional development, upskilling, and freelance projects. Created a personal developer portfolio and earned certifications in C# and TypeScript. Built a fully functional construction company website for a friend, featuring a responsive design, service pages, and contact forms. Developed secure full-stack applications using Node.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, deployed via AWS and Docker. Practiced test-driven development (TDD) and contributed to continuous integration pipelines in freelance and open-source projects. Designed client-side interfaces with responsive UIs, and implemented backend logic with RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

work.title: Full Stack Developer & QA Analyst
work.description: Encubate Tech Pvt. Ltd. is a technology services company providing innovative solutions in AI-driven automation and recruitment technologies. As a Full Stack Developer and QA Analyst, I developed and launched the OCTO feature on the FlexC platform, optimized performance and scalability, and built dynamic interfaces using ReactJS, Redux, and .NET. I also conducted end-to-end testing, including manual testing, API testing using Postman, and automation testing using Playwright. Collaborated in QA retrospectives, UAT to production deployments, and resolved bugs through debugging and root cause analysis.

work.company: John Finch Computers Limited (Client via FlexC)
work.title: Full Stack Developer

Built and integrated secure RESTful APIs to meet client-specific requirements. Enhanced performance and scalability through application optimization, while collaborating with the security team to align with corporate security policies. work.title: Full Stack Developer
